label: 隐式融合体
description: 在 Geometry DSL 末尾追加 sdf_blob(primitives, operations, resolution, bounds) 一行：把多个 SDF primitive（sphere/capsule/box/cone/ellipsoid）用 smooth-union/subtract/intersect 组合成一个连续隐式场，再用真正的 Marching Cubes 提取等值面网格。何时用：需要多个基础体平滑融合成一个连续有机体（怪物躯干、根须、融合肌肉块），常规倒角/圆边继续用 g_fillet，硬布尔拼接继续用 g_union/g_difference/g_intersection。产物是三角网格（非 OCCT 实体），不能再参与 union/difference/intersection/fillet/chamfer——继承 rock/pipe/section_loft 的既有限制。
description-en: Append `sdf_blob(primitives, operations, resolution, bounds)`: combine multiple SDF primitives (sphere/capsule/box/cone/ellipsoid) via smooth-union/subtract/intersect into one continuous implicit field, then extract the isosurface with real Marching Cubes. Use when several base shapes need to fuse smoothly into one continuous organic form (monster torso, tentacle roots, fused muscle masses); keep using g_fillet for ordinary edge rounding and g_union/g_difference/g_intersection for hard CSG. The result is a triangle mesh (not an OCCT solid) and cannot feed union/difference/intersection/fillet/chamfer, same limitation as rock/pipe/section_loft.

inputs.name: primitives
inputs.label: 基础体列表
inputs.description: JSON 数组，每项 {type:'sphere'|'capsule'|'box'|'cone'|'ellipsoid', id, center:[x,y,z], params:[p0,p1,p2], rotation?:[rx,ry,rz]}。params 含义随 type 变化：sphere=[radius,_,_]；capsule=[radius,halfHeight,_]（沿本地 Z 轴）；box=[hx,hy,hz]（半边长）；cone=[radius,height,_]；ellipsoid=[rx,ry,rz]。rotation 为欧拉角（弧度，XYZ 顺序），默认 [0,0,0]。1~64 项
inputs.description-en: JSON array, each {type:'sphere'|'capsule'|'box'|'cone'|'ellipsoid', id, center:[x,y,z], params:[p0,p1,p2], rotation?:[rx,ry,rz]}. params meaning depends on type: sphere=[radius,_,_]; capsule=[radius,halfHeight,_] (along local Z); box=[hx,hy,hz] (half-extents); cone=[radius,height,_]; ellipsoid=[rx,ry,rz]. rotation is Euler angles in radians (XYZ order), default [0,0,0]. 1-64 items.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.label: 融合操作列表
inputs.description: JSON 数组，每项 {type:'smooth-union'|'subtract'|'intersect', id, left, right, radius}。left/right 引用 primitive 或更早 operation 的 id（只能引用列表里排在自己之前的节点），radius 是平滑过渡半径（米，仅 smooth-union 生效，其它类型忽略）。省略时所有 primitive 直接做普通 union。0~128 项
inputs.description-en: JSON array, each {type:'smooth-union'|'subtract'|'intersect', id, left, right, radius}. left/right reference an earlier primitive/operation id (forward references are rejected); radius is the smoothing blend radius in meters (only used by smooth-union). Omit to plain-union all primitives. 0-128 items.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.label: 体素分辨率
inputs.description: Marching Cubes 采样网格分辨率（每轴体素数），4~64；越大越光滑但耗时按立方增长
inputs.description-en: Marching Cubes sampling grid resolution (voxels per axis), 4-64; higher is smoother but cost grows cubically.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.label: 采样边界
inputs.description: JSON 数组 [minx,miny,minz,maxx,maxy,maxz]（米）；省略则按 primitives 的包围球自动外扩计算
inputs.description-en: JSON array [minx,miny,minz,maxx,maxy,maxz] (meters); omit to auto-derive from the primitives' bounding spheres.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 自定义 id；空 = 自动 blob{n}

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 sdf_blob 行后的 Geometry

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.description: 本行结果的 id（供下游 g_part 引用；不能作为 CSG 输入）
outputs.description-en: Id of the result line (for downstream g_part; cannot feed CSG ops).

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: 错误
outputs.description: primitives/operations 解析失败、类型非法、id 引用未知/越界、resolution 越界时的原因；非空表示未追加任何几何
outputs.description-en: Reason when primitives/operations fail to parse, have an invalid type, reference an unknown/forward id, or resolution is out of range. Non-empty means nothing was appended.
